title: Ransomware: shadow-copy deletion -> mass encryption -> C2

anomaly.summary: Anomaly trigger: burst of file-modify events rewriting documents to a .locky extension on FIN-WS-07
anomaly.spl: index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog:sysmon event=file_modified | where like(target_filename,"%.locky") | stats count by host

decoy_hypothesis.statement: H1: The threat is the malware flagged on {bf_ip} — an antivirus hit on eicar.com — so the IT lab host is patient zero.
decoy_hypothesis.seed_spl: index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog:sysmon | where like(target_filename,"%eicar%") | stats count by target_filename | rename target_filename as src_ip

refutation.no_success_reason: the eicar.com host shows zero encryption or shadow-copy deletion activity

corrected_hypothesis.statement: H2: The real incident is ransomware on FIN-WS-07: a macro-spawned PowerShell deleted volume shadow copies (vssadmin/wbadmin/bcdedit), then svch0st.exe encrypted 8 documents to .locky and dropped READ_ME_TO_DECRYPT.txt, while beaconing to a known Locky C2 — the EICAR hit is unrelated test noise.
corroborating_spl: index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog:sysmon event=process_create | where like(command_line,"%vssadmin%") OR like(command_line,"%delete shadows%") OR like(command_line,"%wbadmin%") | table host,command_line
index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog:sysmon event=file_modified | where like(target_filename,"%.locky") | stats count by host
corrected_hypothesis.rationale: SPL shows recovery inhibition followed by a mass-encryption burst and a ransom note on FIN-WS-07 — a corroborated ransomware chain.

root_cause: A malicious macro in Invoice_April.docm spawned an encoded PowerShell stager on FIN-WS-07; it inhibited recovery by deleting volume shadow copies and backup catalogs, then ran svch0st.exe to encrypt user documents to .locky and beacon to a Locky C2 at 203.0.113.77.

host_queries: index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog:sysmon event=file_modified | where like(target_filename,"%.locky") | stats count by host
blast_radius.identity_query: index=endpoint sourcetype=xmlwineventlog:sysmon | where like(target_filename,"%.locky") | dedup user | table user

remediation: Network-isolate FIN-WS-07 immediately while preserving volatile memory for forensics.
Block egress to the Locky C2 203.0.113.77 at the edge firewall.
Verify and restore the finance documents from offsite/immutable backups (local shadow copies are gone).
Hunt for svch0st.exe and the encoded PowerShell stager across all endpoints.
Reset credentials used on FIN-WS-07 and disable Office macros from the internet via GPO.
Add correlation searches for (vssadmin/wbadmin delete) and (mass rename to known ransom extensions).
